headline: BIG NUMBERS, TOUGH QUESTIONS - OrissaPOST
summary: India's economy grew 7.8% in the first quarter of the fiscal year, which the government attributes to reforms, manufacturing, services and rising investment. Critics question what the figure really shows.
why: GDP growth is the broadest measure of India's economic momentum, guiding expectations for corporate earnings, rates and foreign investment.
